contests.title: Markesan School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote:
BE IT RESOLVED by the Board of Education of the
Markesan District Schools that the revenues included in the District budget be authorized
to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $700,000
in each of four (4) consecutive years for the 2026-2027, 2027-2028, 2028-2029, and
2029-2030 school years, for nonrecurring purposes.

contests.title: Montello School District — Temporary school-revenue increase

provenance.quote: BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the Montello School District, Marquette and Green Lake Counties, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $2,000,000 in each year for the 2026-2027 school year, the 2027-2028 school year, the 2028-2029 school year and the 2029-2030 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operational and maintenance expenses, including for educational programming, facility maintenance and employee compensation and benefits.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $700,000 a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for four school years, from 2026–27 through 2029–30, to maintain school programs and operations. This temporary authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $2 million a year above Wisconsin’s school-revenue limit for four school years, from 2026–27 through 2029–30. It would pay for operations and maintenance, including educational programs, facility maintenance, and employee compensation and benefits. This temporary authorization ends after those years.
